name: bank
title_zh: 问余额前先替你查好账本的银行管家
tagline_zh: 月底对账总差几笔？它直接调你的银行接口，把账户、收支、订阅全捋顺，连「那笔钱到没到」都替你盯，不用再翻App截图。
tagline_en: Reconcile month-end gaps? It pulls your bank MCP directly, sorts accounts, income, subscriptions, and tracks.
desc_en: Answer questions about the user's own bank accounts and money using the bank MCP tools (list_accounts, get_balances, get_transactions, watches). Use whenever the user asks about balances, spending, income, subscriptions, whether a payment arrived, or wants a monthly review. Encodes the account map and categorisation rules so answers are consistent.
why_zh: 它把账户映射和分类规则写死在技能里，每次回答都基于同一套账本逻辑，不会这次说A下次说B。
why_en: Account map and categorization rules are baked into the skill, so every answer uses the same ledger logic—no flip-flopping.
limit_zh: 只认你已配置好的 bank MCP 工具，没接银行接口或没授权账户列表，它只能干瞪眼；不负责记账。
limit_en: Requires your bank MCP tools configured and accounts authorized; it answers from existing transactions only, doesn't bookkeep or forecast.
title_en: Bank teller that checks your ledger before answering.
